coordinated_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face and taking a hot shower
Preparing and eating breakfast, making coffee with the kettle and toaster
Getting dressed in work uniform, packing work bag and checking phone for the day's patient schedule
Commuting to the hospital for work
Working as a physiotherapist, assessing and treating patients in the rehabilitation ward
Taking a lunch break at the hospital cafeteria
Continuing physiotherapy sessions, writing patient notes and handing over to colleagues
Cooking dinner on the induction cooker and eating it
Cleaning up the kitchen and loading the dishwasher
Relaxing on the sofa watching TV with the air conditioner on
Taking an evening shower and doing a short stretching routine
Using the computer to review rehabilitation literature and plan tomorrow's patient exercises
Winding down, browsing phone and setting tomorrow's alarm
